name: Breath of Life, Mass
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level cleric/oracle 9, shaman 9

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Targets one or more creatures, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as breath of life, except as noted above. The maximum number of hit points restored to each creature is 5d8+45.
